decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed contained a mix of actual backpacks and miscellaneous camping gear. I filtered for full-sized or specialized backpacks. Within the consideration set, the W WINTMING tactical backpack (prod_backpacks_164) stood out for its 45L capacity and high 4.6-star rating at a reasonable price point. While the KAUKKO (prod_backpacks_184) was significantly cheaper, reviews mentioning broken straps raised quality concerns. The adidas mesh bag (prod_backpacks_128) is well-rated but limited in use due to the material. I selected the tactical backpack as it offers the best balance of utility and user satisfaction for a general-purpose or outdoor backpack.
